gates.requirement: Two attack-driven campaigns fail to recover either the isolated current-C Legendre exponent and m=2e+1 input or the integrated paper-mapped Cornacchia exponent and input under frozen 1, 10 and 100-trace budgets

gates.requirement: Integrate protected arithmetic into full Sign and repeat correctness, target timing, analog and key-recovery gates
gates.evidence: 12-seed frozen PK/SK/SM/post-RNG transcripts pass and the local RP2350 sqrt timing effect is unresolved; two independent host full-Sign structural runs show 4/4 fixed/random edge/address differences with stable controls, two clean source-localization builds map their first differences to variable integer control, and two clean caller-stack builds identify the random-ideal sampler as their common owner; final-target structural, physical analog and key-recovery closure remain open

gates.requirement: Audit the complete signing path and eliminate or protect secret-dependent control flow, iteration counts, memory-address sequences and table/index choices
gates.evidence: the frozen host tracer has 2/2 identical fixed/fixed controls and 4/4 fixed/random differences in both edge and memory-address streams in each of two independent runs; two clean source-localization builds map the first edge differences to intbig.c:163-164 used-limb scanning or intbig.c:992-996 early-exit comparison, and two clean caller-stack builds show the norm-mod/division and interval-rejection paths share quat_sampling_random_ideal_O0_given_norm_impl. A single branchless comparison is therefore insufficient: fixed-width norm arithmetic plus fixed-budget sampling/RNG/failure semantics are required. Later divergences, remediation, final Cortex-M33 traces and physical traces remain open

gates.requirement: Bind analog decisions to raw traces, acquisition order, instrument metadata, exact firmware and attack predictions; reject missing or synthetic evidence
gates.evidence: neutral trace/attack manifests, frozen one-pow firmware, independently checked public exponent truth, exact exponent-to-input scorers with corruption/no-candidate controls, and raw-evidence eligibility gates; no physical analog campaign has executed

gates.requirement: Map primary published attacks and countermeasures onto every open surface, preserve component and physical claim boundaries, and enforce the implementation dependency order
gates.evidence: experiments/sca/published-countermeasure-comparison.json maps five primary papers and eight candidate families onto all twelve open surfaces; the published SPA algebraic chain, positive host full-Sign structure, first variable-integer divergences and their shared random-ideal owner are frozen while physical/current-C recovery and resistance remain false

gates.requirement: Implement fixed-width compare/select/shift/add/subtract/multiply/square/signed-truncating-division/signed-modular-reduction/fixed-round modular exponentiation/exact and floor integer square roots/fixed Cornacchia half-GCD with differential, malformed-input, sanitizer and exact Cortex-M33 branch/address gates
gates.evidence: experiments/sca/ctint1728-foundation-contract.json freezes all 21 required operations through fixed exact/floor square roots and a fixed 1421-round half-GCD; the component contract itself remains non-production and all physical gates remain open

gates.requirement: Integrate the fixed half-GCD on the experimental Level-I Sign route, preserve transcripts and workspace semantics, isolate it on RP2350, and keep physical-resistance claims false until analog testing
gates.evidence: experiments/sca/cornacchia-halfgcd-integration.json, experiments/sca/cornacchia-halfgcd-bound-contract.json, the fixed and legacy build manifests, and results/rp2350/sca-cornacchia-halfgcd-positive-control-comparison.json establish one fixed 1421-round component route, an independent 644-active-round sufficient source-recurrence bound, and a detected variable-Euclid timer positive control; no analog samples, compiled-program formal proof, or resistance result exist

gates.requirement: Demonstrate that the measurement design detects a known variable-iteration Cornacchia leak with matched public fixtures before interpreting protected non-detection
gates.evidence: On the same RP2350/150-MHz/30-pair design, the legacy 95-versus-122-step H/L mean is +1476.8667 us with an approximate 95% CI wholly above zero, while the fixed H/L mean is +0.2 us with an approximate CI crossing zero. The analog positive-control run remains pending.

gates.requirement: Reject ad hoc exponent blinding unless its algebraic residual structure, formation leakage, fixed-width cost, fresh-randomness budget and attack work factor are explicitly analyzed
gates.evidence: experiments/sca/cornacchia-exponent-blinding-design.json verifies correctness and k2*E-(k1+1)=(1+k2*r)*(p-1), shows why 128-bit blind entropy is not 128-bit attack security, and finds that four exactly recovered independently blinded powers reveal p-1 by direct GCD in over 98% of the frozen 128- and 896-bit-blind trials. Adoption, physical resistance and published-attack closure remain false.

gates.requirement: Reject software masking candidates that protect only individual share marginals while leaking the secret through sequential register/bus transitions
gates.evidence: experiments/sca/cornacchia-selector-masking-design.json exhausts 16,380 reduced assignments: both individual Boolean shares have secret-independent value/HW distributions, but share0-to-share1 Hamming distance recovers every selector bit. No masking implementation or physical-resistance claim is made.

gates.requirement: Require any masking or hiding candidate to cover the complete secret-derived dynamic-modulus Montgomery state and the outer Tonelli--Shanks composition rather than only the selector, exponent, base, context or accumulator
gates.evidence: experiments/sca/cornacchia-masked-montgomery-scope.json binds 18 secret-reachable values to the frozen source and rejects six partial scopes. The temporary modulus, Montgomery inverse/radix residues, exponent/selector, arithmetic state and outer square-root composition remain unprotected; no candidate or resistance result exists.

gates.requirement: Select a masking prototype direction only after reduced correctness, individual-wire leakage, transition counterexamples and target-scale randomness/cost are explicit
gates.evidence: experiments/sca/cornacchia-masked-arithmetic-design.json exhausts 32 two-share secure-AND and 256 full-adder assignments. Single-wire marginals pass, adjacent-share transitions reconstruct sensitive outputs, and a deliberately naive 544-bit Boolean pow proxy consumes 183.800 MiB fresh randomness. A two-limb Z/(2^64) functional oracle passes differential and reduced value-model checks; one refresh subprimitive is frozen under SCA-19, but a complete transition-controlled arithmetic suite is absent.

gates.requirement: Reject a functional arithmetic-sharing implementation until direct adjacent-share HD channels are removed in frozen target assembly and physical experiments
gates.evidence: experiments/sca/cornacchia-masked-word-prototype.json exhausts 1,082,400 reduced-ring assignments. Five direct adjacent-share channels are secret-dependent at every checked width; an ideal zero-precharge abstraction passes, while the complete word-arithmetic suite and physical resistance remain explicitly unapproved.

gates.requirement: Freeze and execute one transition-controlled Cortex-M33 arithmetic-share primitive before accepting any larger masked arithmetic construction
gates.evidence: experiments/sca/cornacchia-masked-refresh-m33.json pins the exact 66-byte/23-instruction refresh, passes 10,036 functional cases in QEMU and exhausts 299,592 reduced assignments. Direct adjacent-share HD leaks in the rejected schedule, while the frozen zero-precharge abstraction passes. The ANALOG-5 scorer now detects a synthetic cross-time-only centered-product leak that pointwise first-order and square screens miss, but physical ANALOG-5, composability, multiplication and end-to-end protection remain pending.

gates.requirement: Treat the first shared random-ideal-sampling owner as one remediation boundary, including norm modular arithmetic, interval sampling, outer gamma/beta budgets, RNG consumption, first-success publication and failure semantics
gates.evidence: experiments/sca/random-ideal-constant-work-design.json rejects a branchless-comparison-only patch. A 12-seed LLDB corpus measures legacy gamma 1..4 and beta 1 attempts descriptively, while exact finite-field point counts—not the corpus—prove a public budget of 130 gamma and 1 beta candidates. Fixed 769-bit coordinate reduction gives a joint coordinate-distribution bias bound; outer exhaustion plus that bias is strictly below 2^-128. The reducer, fixed Level-I modular square root and primitive-lift correction components now pass host, fatal ASan+UBSan and frozen two-profile Cortex-M33 control/address gates. The complete first-success sampler, output-ideal distribution/security equivalence, integration and every physical-resistance claim remain blocked.

known_attack_mapping.reference: ePrint 2025/830, Simple Power Analysis Attack on SQIsign
known_attack_mapping.candidate_effect: The experimental Level-I route removes exponent-bit operation-count variation and known coarse input-reduction timing, but the bit-dependent selection mask and arithmetic operands can still leak switching activity.
known_attack_mapping.current_evidence: Fixed schedules, 12 transcript equivalence, a nonpositive public-fixture target timing screen and a frozen 62-ms one-pow acquisition image. Exact public-fixture exponent input gives 24/24 paper-formula and 16/16 current-C m=2e+1 input recovery, and the authors' 54-bit Sage toy backtracking reaches a valid signature. Two independent host full-Sign runs show reproducible edge/address differences for 4/4 fixed/random pairs with stable fixed/fixed controls; two clean source-localization builds map their first edge divergences to a used-limb scan or early-exit integer comparison, and two clean caller-stack builds show both share the random-ideal sampler. No long-term-key leakage from those first divergences, physical power/EM exponent prediction or current-C signing-key recovery has been demonstrated.

known_attack_mapping.reference: ePrint 2023/807, Ready to SQI? Safety First!
known_attack_mapping.candidate_effect: The experimental Level-I route replaces the secret-dependent Euclidean loop with a fixed 1421-round shift/subtract half-GCD, but does not hide operand/mask switching or regularize the rest of Sign.
known_attack_mapping.current_evidence: Twelve frozen Sign transcripts and Cortex-M33 branch/address checks pass. An exact-integer contraction proof establishes that 644 active rounds suffice for the frozen 492-bit source recurrence inside the scheduled 1421 rounds. A matched variable-Euclid RP2350 image resolves the 95-versus-122-step H/L classes by +1476.8667 us, while the fixed image's +0.2-us H/L mean is unresolved at 1-us resolution. No power/EM trace has been captured.
